sources.title: E-commerce support software landscape 2026
sources.snippet: Zendesk and Intercom dominate customer support software overall and both now ship AI agents as a standard feature rather than an add-on. Intercom's Fin agent is bundled into its mid-tier plans. Shopify also ships native support tooling to merchants on its platform at no additional cost, which covers a large share of the small-merchant segment.

sources.title: Support software category sizing
sources.snippet: Customer support software is estimated at $11-14B in 2026 growing 17-21%. The e-commerce-specific slice is roughly $1.5-2B. Gorgias and Tidio are real but small players within it.

sources.title: Pricing pressure from bundled AI agents
sources.snippet: Per-resolution pricing for AI support agents fell through 2025 and 2026 as platform vendors bundled the capability. Standalone vendors report compressed expansion revenue.
